comment: Ultimate's up tilt (c02attackhi3): on her knees, looking up, bending back, the staff spinning above her hand off her palm (owner p6p). Ultimate's facing (owner p6r: the Ultimate data "should be more authoritative than the 3DS mp4s"; the 3DS's turn toward the camera put her staff's thrust off her plane). Retargeted onto her rig by scripts/p6/ultimate.py from the owner's local Ultimate files (never committed, P6 D1). Owner p6s ("leaning back far, facing upwards twirling staff like the limbo or the matrix"): her torso turned 25 degrees and her head 40 more toward her facing through the spin, her hair turned back by both so it falls as Ultimate's does ("turn", ultimate.py).
